record.question: For malaria elimination, states are divided into how many categories based on API, ABER and SPR?
record.explanation: Official final key: C — 4. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 13, printed Q73. Source limitation: The stem conflates different malaria classification frameworks and omits the guideline edition; no unique category count is established. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
